sourceTitle: An Essay on Professional Ethics Second Edition
description: "An Essay on Professional Ethics" by George Sharswood is a scholarly work on the ethical responsibilities and moral duties of legal practitioners written in the mid-19th century. The text explores the importance of integrity in the legal profession, emphasizing the complex moral dilemmas that lawyers face as they navigate their obligations to their clients, the courts, and society at large.
